title: Choose the quieter portfolio direction
question: These options remove the craft-menu styling. They use calm space, precise structure, and real product work to present you as a serious mobile engineer.

options.label: Product First
options.thesis: Let shipped mobile work carry the page, with your name and role acting as a quiet frame around it.
options.lineage: Calm Japanese corporate design, with Panasonic-like space and Keyence-like product clarity.
options.materials: Real app screens, generous white space, precise dividers, plain language, and one muted accent.
options.viewport: A large Guusto product screen occupies the left side. A compact right column contains your name, React Native focus, six years of ownership, Felipe's recommendation, and simple Work and Resume links.
options.strength: Feels calm, credible, and immediately grounded in a real production app.
options.risk: It depends on choosing a strong, legible crop from the product imagery.

options.label: Quiet Professional Profile
options.thesis: Establish trust through a modest portrait and concise introduction, then let the products prove the details.
options.lineage: Osaka corporate design pages that pair a real person with a careful, direct statement.
options.materials: Natural portrait photography, measured typography, real product imagery, and open space.
options.viewport: Your portrait sits beside a restrained role headline and three factual points. A quiet strip below previews Guusto and KiraKiran without card decoration.
options.strength: Warm and trustworthy without sounding self-promotional.
options.risk: It is more familiar and can lean toward a conventional corporate biography.

options.label: Engineering Evidence Index
options.thesis: Use a clean index of products, ownership, platforms, and proof instead of a promotional hero section.
options.lineage: The precision of Japanese technical product catalogues and well-structured corporate information architecture.
options.materials: Product rows, clear headings, thin dividers, short factual descriptions, and full-colour screenshots.
options.viewport: A compact name and role header leads directly into four indexed project rows, with Guusto expanded to show production ownership and mobile QA evidence.
options.strength: Efficient, precise, and easy for engineering leaders to scan.
options.risk: It can feel less personal than the other two directions.

canon.label: Conventional international portfolio
canon.thesis: A polished hero followed by project cards, skills, recommendations, and contact information.
canon.strength: Clear and familiar to international recruiters.
canon.risk: It can resemble many other strong developer portfolios.
